title: Lendenfeldaranes W–Y, new 24-homoscalaranes from a marine sponge Lendenfeldia species
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44877-44882
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07083J, Paper

Chih-Yin Huang, Bo-Rong Peng, Yueh-Wen Liu, You-Ying Chen, Jui-Hsin Su, Chia-Ching Liaw, Jih-Jung Chen, Chung-Chih Tseng, Yu-Jen Wu, Yuan-Bin Cheng, Lun Kelvin Tsou, Mingzi M. Zhang, Zhi-Hong Wen, Li-Guo Zheng, Ping-Jyun Sung
Three new scalarane-type sesterterpenoids, lendenfeldaranes W–Y (1–3), along with a known analogue, lendenfeldarane D (4), were isolated from a marine sponge identified as Lendenfeldia species.
